electric cable noun

also power cable, electric cord, electrical cable

modern

Traupman 309

fūniculus ēlectricus

electric cord, power cable

Traupman explicitly records this phrase.

Examples

  • Fūniculum ēlectricum affer.

    Bring the electrical cable.composed

See also extension cord, cord, cable reel.
